run_pretrain: run the pretrain script to start multi-GPU VarNet training for banding removal on fastMRI data
configure_varnet_trainer: configure the VarNetTrainer with method_str, sens_method_str, and magic mask type for banding removal
set_training_hyperparameters: set training hyperparameters including epochs, batch_size, learning rate, and SSIM loss coefficient
configure_kspace_data: configure k-space data parameters including acceleration factors, low frequencies, and coil count
run_spawn_dist: run spawn_dist with the config dictionary to launch distributed training across multiple GPUs
